rules: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and clearly visible
No shadows, glare, or flash reflections
Photo must be no more than 6 months old

NOT PUBLISHED BY IRCC: confirmed directly against the source on 2026-09-11 — Canada's guidance specifies head height (chin-to-crown) and centred, squared framing, but no eye-line position from the bottom of the photo. The range below is a deliberately wide placeholder that cannot itself cause a false rejection; it is not a sourced target and this is not expected to change with more research.
